comment: Detrimental cast-on-you landing lines, message -> candidate spells. Used by BuffLossLog to name what displaced a buff. Grouped by message because several debuffs share a line; the loss entry shows the shared line's candidates rather than guessing one. Generated by scripts/harvests/eqlwiki/debuffs-harvest.py - regenerate, never hand-edit. Exclusions in debuffs-report.md.
